details:
Project Details – Space Legacy Explorer: Every Mission Leaves a Legacy

Space Legacy Explorer is an interactive web-based platform designed to make space exploration more engaging, informative, and accessible. It allows users to explore the history and achievements of lunar missions, understand important discoveries, and learn how each mission has contributed to humanity's progress in space exploration.

The platform aims to connect past space missions with future possibilities by presenting information in an engaging and user-friendly format. Its main benefit is making complex space-related information easier to understand, especially for students, space enthusiasts, and beginners.

Our intended impact is to increase awareness about lunar exploration, encourage scientific curiosity, and inspire the next generation to learn more about space science and technology.

The project is developed as a web application using modern web development technologies and deployed through Vercel. It is designed to be accessible through a web browser without requiring specialized hardware.

The creative aspect of our project is its mission-based approach, where every space mission is presented as part of a larger legacy of exploration and discovery. During development, we considered user experience, simplicity, accessibility, educational value, information presentation, and the importance of making space exploration interesting for different age groups.
